scope: One local macOS ReleaseSafe two-step Bitcoin first-retarget fold run. The per-step guard times exclude value-circuit construction, the prover, native verification, and serialization. The prior prover timer also excluded this guard, so the measured saving is setup time, not a reduction of prove_seconds.
change: Compare all 45 ordered preprocessed column ids, lengths, and M31 values plus first_permutation_row and n_outputs to the sealed witness-free circuit, instead of recomputing the value circuit's FFT/Merkle preprocessed root on every fold step. The sealed circuit is still the one supplied to the prover.
